estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete reason or through-reference interval claim
estimand_contract.contrast: Registered ordinary Because/Ever since wording minus concise complete English with the same reason or interval assertion; no invented marker syntax, bare-since comparison or explicit no-cause padding
estimand_contract.population: Prospective 64-pair operational journal population: 32 per form, all nine declared domains; 3 or 4 fresh contexts per form-domain cell, with equal domain and form weights

aggregation.rule: For each tokenizer, equal-weight mean of the 18 form-domain cell means; report maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), with exact member-span bounds

manifest.method: New original under the registered surfaces; not a replication of the invalid invented-wrapper source. Canonical SDK token_measurement prepare -> mint -> run_prepared -> verify -> measure. No encoding before mint.
manifest.scope: Current reference tokenizer cost only. This result does not measure comprehension or establish future-trained efficiency.
